Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

For AIDS awareness month this year, the two opening speakers, a gay man and a pansexual man, were very carefully chosen. The pansexual man will talk about having lost a close friend to AIDS just last year, and the gay man will talk about recent personal experiences being targeted for being HIV positive. Who is likely HIV negative?
A. The pansexual man
B. Unknown
C. The gay man
